annotations.title: Payday loan APR and renewal cost

description: The paydayloan.help cost calculator: from the amount borrowed, the fee per $100 and the days until due, returns the APR, the fee per period, total fees after a number of fee-only renewals, the principal still owed, and the same amount as a federal credit union payday alternative loan (PAL) at the 28% maximum rate: monthly payment and total interest.

days.description: Days from taking the loan to its due date, e.g. 14.

fee_per_100.description: Fee charged per $100 borrowed for one loan period, e.g. 15.

pal_months.description: Months to repay the comparison PAL (PAL I allows 1 to 6, PAL II 1 to 12).

renewals.description: Times the loan was renewed, rolled over or re-borrowed right after payoff (fee-only).

name: payday_loan_cost
title: Payday loan APR and renewal cost
